atoms.b: Peas disperse their seeds by ((++explosion wind)).
This happens when the pod ((++dries_up gets_wet)) and opens. When the pod explodes, it throws out the peas that contain the ((++seeds eggs)).

instruction.text: Select the plant that disperses its seeds via explosion.

trainers.hint: Which seed is encased in a pod?

instruction.text: Put the stages of seed dispersal into the correct order, with the first step at the top. You can select each image to hear a description.

atoms.sound: the peapod grows on the plant
the peapod dries up, opens and peas explode out of it
the pea, which contains the seed, lands on the soil
from the pea, a new plant grows
